text: Mulch is an important soil additive that enriches the soil, reduces weed growth, and retains moisture. Compost is another valuable soil supplement that adds nutrients to the soil and creates a fertile, inviting environment for root growth. By using both mulch and compost, gardeners can cultivate a healthy, thriving garden ecosystem. Mulch helps control weeds, while compost enriches the soil, making it more fertile and inviting to root growth.
